title: Junction: a VS Code sidebar that runs your local coding agent inside the editor

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Running a local coding agent from a separate terminal means constant context switching and copy pasting between two windows. Junction pulls it inside VS Code, a chat sidebar for local AI coding agents that lives right next to your code. Point it at files, watch changes land in your project, never leave the editor.
